# Contract: Google Authentication

*Generated by spec-writer. Hand edits are overwritten on regeneration.*

## Prerequisites

These conditions describe the environment in which items in this
contract are exercised. Producing them is part of the feature's
deliverable, alongside the implementation itself — a contract whose
prerequisites are not yet satisfied is not failing, it is still being
built. Once the feature is delivered, any missing condition halts item
execution until it is restored.

**Runtime services:**
- The e2e stack from `docker/docker-compose.e2e.yml` is running and healthy: `api`, `worker`, `db`, `wiremock`, and the stub `web` service publishing `127.0.0.1:8080`.
- Every HTTP item is sent to `http://127.0.0.1:8080`, which proxies `/api` to `api`.
- The `db` service is reachable for reading and writing the `users` and `sessions` tables, and every migration through F02's is applied.
- The api's stdout log stream is readable (e.g. `docker compose logs api`).

**Persistent state:**
- `no-users` — the `users` and `sessions` tables are empty. Used by: API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-01, API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-02, API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-03, API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-04, API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-05, API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-06, API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-07, API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-08, API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-09, CLI-LOGIN-LOG-01.
- `pedro` — the single user exists with email `pedro@example.com`, Google subject `google-sub-pedro`, name `Pedro`, and avatar URL `https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/test`. Used by: API-ACCESS-02, API-PROFILE-01, API-LOGOUT-01, API-LOGOUT-02, API-EXPIRY-01, API-EXPIRY-02, API-EXPIRY-03, API-EXPIRY-04.
- `active-token` / `pedro-active-session` — a session for `pedro` whose raw token is a known 43-character base64url value `active-token`; the row stores only its SHA-256 hex; created 1 day ago, last seen 10 minutes ago, `expires_at` = last seen + 30 days, absolute expiry = created + 90 days. Used by: API-ACCESS-02, API-PROFILE-01, API-LOGOUT-01, API-LOGOUT-02, API-EXPIRY-04.
- `idle-token` / `pedro-idle-session` — a session for `pedro` with known raw token `idle-token` (43-char base64url, stored only as its hash); created 40 days ago, last seen 30 days and 1 hour ago, `expires_at` 1 hour in the past. Used by: API-EXPIRY-01.
- `ancient-token` / `pedro-ancient-session` — a session for `pedro` with known raw token `ancient-token` (stored only as its hash); created 90 days and 1 hour ago, last seen 5 minutes ago, `expires_at` and absolute expiry both 1 hour in the past. Used by: API-EXPIRY-02.
- `stale-token` / `pedro-stale-session` — a session for `pedro` with known raw token `stale-token` (stored only as its hash); created 5 days ago, last seen 2 hours ago, `expires_at` = last seen + 30 days. Used by: API-EXPIRY-03.
- `orphan-token` — a 43-character base64url value whose hash matches no session row. Used by: API-ACCESS-03.

**Configuration:**
- `ALLOWED_EMAIL=pedro@example.com`
- `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=test-client-id.apps.googleusercontent.com`, `GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=test-client-secret`
- `SESSION_SECRET` is a test value of at least 32 characters.
- `DASHBOARD_URL=http://localhost:8080/`, `GOOGLE_REDIRECT_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8080`
- `GOOGLE_AUTHORIZE_URL=http://wiremock:8080/o/oauth2/v2/auth`, `GOOGLE_TOKEN_URL=http://wiremock:8080/token`, `GOOGLE_JWKS_URL=http://wiremock:8080/oauth2/v3/certs`, `GOOGLE_ISSUERS=https://accounts.google.com,accounts.google.com`
- Cookie names: `ci_session` (session) and `ci_oauth` (transient login state).
- "A login was started" in an item means: `GET /api/v1/auth/google` was sent, and the `ci_oauth` cookie from its `Set-Cookie` and the `state` query parameter from its `Location` were captured for the item's next request.

**External dependencies:**
- WireMock (service `wiremock`, mappings in `docker/wiremock/mappings/google/`) stands in for Google. Its token endpoint answers `POST /token` only when the form body carries `grant_type=authorization_code`, the test client credentials, and a non-empty `code_verifier`, with behavior keyed by the `code` value:
  - `code-allowed` → 200 with an RS256 ID token: `sub=google-sub-pedro`, `email=pedro@example.com`, `email_verified=true`, `name=Pedro`, `picture=https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/test`, `aud` = the test client ID, `iss=https://accounts.google.com`, `exp` far in the future.
  - `code-other-email` → 200 with the same token shape for `other@example.com`, `email_verified=true`.
  - `code-unverified` → 200 with the same token shape for `pedro@example.com`, `email_verified=false`.
  - `code-expired-token` → 200 with a `code-allowed`-shaped token whose `exp` is in the past.
  - `code-google-error` → HTTP 500.
- `GET /oauth2/v3/certs` on WireMock returns the JWKS containing the public half of the test signing key.
- WireMock's request journal can be queried to count requests received by `POST /token`.
- No item contacts real Google endpoints.

## Coverage Manifest

| PRD Acceptance Criterion | Covered by |
|---|---|
| Login with the email in `ALLOWED_EMAIL` creates a session and sets `ci_session` with HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite=Lax. | API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-01, API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-02 |
| Login with any other email redirects with `error=not_allowed` and creates no session row. | API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-03, API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-04 |
| Callback with a mismatched `state` redirects with `error=invalid_state`. | API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-05, API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-06 |
| Protected routes return 401 without a cookie and 200 with a valid one. | API-ACCESS-01, API-ACCESS-02, API-ACCESS-03 |
| `POST /auth/logout` returns 204, deletes the session row and later requests with the old cookie return 401. | API-LOGOUT-01, API-LOGOUT-02 |
| Session tokens are stored only as SHA-256 hashes. | API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-02 |
| Sessions expire after 30 days of inactivity and after 90 days absolute. | API-EXPIRY-01, API-EXPIRY-02, API-EXPIRY-03 |

## HTTP API

**Verification mode:** Send an HTTP request to the running service; assert response status, headers, body, and any direct persisted side-effect.

### Login start

#### `API-LOGIN-START-01` — redirect to Google with PKCE
- given: the e2e stack is running
- when: GET `/api/v1/auth/google` without following redirects
- then:
  - 302 Found
  - `Location` starts with `GOOGLE_AUTHORIZE_URL` and carries query { client_id: test client ID, redirect_uri: `http://localhost:8080/api/v1/auth/google/callback`, response_type: "code", scope: "openid email profile", code_challenge_method: "S256", state: non-empty, code_challenge: 43-char base64url }
  - `Set-Cookie` for `ci_oauth` with `HttpOnly`, `Secure`, `SameSite=Lax`, `Max-Age=600`
  - no `Set-Cookie` for `ci_session`

### Login callback

**Common given:** `no-users`; a login was started, and its `ci_oauth` cookie and `state` were captured.

#### `API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-01` — allowed email gets a session cookie
- given: (default)
- when: GET `/api/v1/auth/google/callback?code=code-allowed&state=<captured state>` with the captured `ci_oauth` cookie, without following redirects
- then:
  - 302 Found with `Location` equal to `http://localhost:8080/`
  - `Set-Cookie` for `ci_session` with a 43-character base64url value
  - the `ci_session` cookie carries `HttpOnly`, `Secure`, `SameSite=Lax`, and `Path=/`
  - a `Set-Cookie` clears `ci_oauth` (`Max-Age=0`)

#### `API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-02` — allowed login persists the user and only a token hash
- given: (default)
- when: GET `/api/v1/auth/google/callback?code=code-allowed&state=<captured state>` with the captured `ci_oauth` cookie
- then:
  - `users` contains exactly one row, with email `pedro@example.com` and name `Pedro`
  - `sessions` contains exactly one row, referencing that user
  - that row's `token_hash` equals the lowercase SHA-256 hex of the returned `ci_session` cookie value
  - no column of any `sessions` row contains the raw `ci_session` cookie value

#### `API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-03` — other email rejected
- given: (default)
- when: GET `/api/v1/auth/google/callback?code=code-other-email&state=<captured state>` with the captured `ci_oauth` cookie
- then:
  - 302 Found with `Location` equal to `http://localhost:8080/login?error=not_allowed`
  - no `Set-Cookie` for `ci_session`
  - `sessions` is empty
  - `users` is empty

#### `API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-04` — unverified email rejected
- given: (default)
- when: GET `/api/v1/auth/google/callback?code=code-unverified&state=<captured state>` with the captured `ci_oauth` cookie
- then:
  - 302 Found with `Location` equal to `http://localhost:8080/login?error=not_allowed`
  - `sessions` is empty

#### `API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-05` — mismatched state
- given: (default)
- when: GET `/api/v1/auth/google/callback?code=code-allowed&state=tampered-state` with the captured `ci_oauth` cookie
- then:
  - 302 Found with `Location` equal to `http://localhost:8080/login?error=invalid_state`
  - no `Set-Cookie` for `ci_session`
  - `sessions` is empty
  - WireMock's journal shows zero requests to `POST /token` during this item

#### `API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-06` — missing transient cookie
- given: (default)
- when: GET `/api/v1/auth/google/callback?code=code-allowed&state=<captured state>` without any cookie
- then:
  - 302 Found with `Location` equal to `http://localhost:8080/login?error=invalid_state`
  - `sessions` is empty

#### `API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-07` — Google token endpoint failure
- given: (default)
- when: GET `/api/v1/auth/google/callback?code=code-google-error&state=<captured state>` with the captured `ci_oauth` cookie
- then:
  - 302 Found with `Location` equal to `http://localhost:8080/login?error=google_unavailable`
  - `sessions` is empty

#### `API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-08` — expired ID token
- given: (default)
- when: GET `/api/v1/auth/google/callback?code=code-expired-token&state=<captured state>` with the captured `ci_oauth` cookie
- then:
  - 302 Found with `Location` equal to `http://localhost:8080/login?error=invalid_token`
  - `sessions` is empty

#### `API-LOGIN-CALLBACK-09` — user cancels consent
- given: (default)
- when: GET `/api/v1/auth/google/callback?error=access_denied&state=<captured state>` with the captured `ci_oauth` cookie
- then:
  - 302 Found with `Location` equal to `http://localhost:8080/login?error=access_denied`
  - WireMock's journal shows zero requests to `POST /token` during this item

### Access control

#### `API-ACCESS-01` — no cookie
- given: the e2e stack is running
- when: GET `/api/v1/me` without cookies
- then:
  - 401 Unauthorized
  - body `{ error: { code: "UNAUTHENTICATED", message: "Authentication required. Sign in with Google.", correlationId } }`

#### `API-ACCESS-02` — valid session
- given: `pedro` and `pedro-active-session` exist
- when: GET `/api/v1/me` with cookie `ci_session=<active-token>`
- then:
  - 200 OK
  - body `user.email` is `pedro@example.com`

#### `API-ACCESS-03` — unknown session cookie
- given: the e2e stack is running; `orphan-token` matches no session
- when: GET `/api/v1/me` with cookie `ci_session=<orphan-token>`
- then:
  - 401 Unauthorized with `error.code` "UNAUTHENTICATED"
  - `error.message` is "Session expired. Sign in again."
  - `Set-Cookie` clears `ci_session` (`Max-Age=0`)

#### `API-ACCESS-04` — public routes need no session
- given: the e2e stack is running
- when: GET `/api/v1/health` without cookies
- then:
  - 200 OK

### Current user

#### `API-PROFILE-01` — profile with default integration statuses
- given: `pedro` and `pedro-active-session` exist
- when: GET `/api/v1/me` with cookie `ci_session=<active-token>`
- then:
  - 200 OK
  - body `user` equals { email: "pedro@example.com", name: "Pedro", avatarUrl: "https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/test" }
  - body `integrations.youtube.status` is "disconnected"
  - body `integrations.telegram.status` is "not_configured"

### Logout

#### `API-LOGOUT-01` — logout deletes the session
- given: `pedro` and `pedro-active-session` exist
- when: POST `/api/v1/auth/logout` with cookie `ci_session=<active-token>`
- then:
  - 204 No Content with an empty body
  - `Set-Cookie` clears `ci_session` (`Max-Age=0`, `Path=/`)
  - the `pedro-active-session` row no longer exists

#### `API-LOGOUT-02` — old cookie rejected after logout
- given: `pedro` and `pedro-active-session` existed, and POST `/api/v1/auth/logout` with `ci_session=<active-token>` has returned 204
- when: GET `/api/v1/me` with cookie `ci_session=<active-token>`
- then:
  - 401 Unauthorized with `error.code` "UNAUTHENTICATED"

#### `API-LOGOUT-03` — logout without a session is idempotent
- given: the e2e stack is running
- when: POST `/api/v1/auth/logout` without cookies
- then:
  - 204 No Content
  - `Set-Cookie` clears `ci_session`

### Session expiry

**Common given:** `pedro` exists.

#### `API-EXPIRY-01` — 30 days of inactivity
- given: (default), and `pedro-idle-session` exists
- when: GET `/api/v1/me` with cookie `ci_session=<idle-token>`
- then:
  - 401 Unauthorized with `error.message` "Session expired. Sign in again."
  - `Set-Cookie` clears `ci_session`
  - the `pedro-idle-session` row no longer exists

#### `API-EXPIRY-02` — 90-day absolute limit despite recent activity
- given: (default), and `pedro-ancient-session` exists
- when: GET `/api/v1/me` with cookie `ci_session=<ancient-token>`
- then:
  - 401 Unauthorized with `error.message` "Session expired. Sign in again."
  - the `pedro-ancient-session` row no longer exists

#### `API-EXPIRY-03` — activity extends an idle-aged session
- given: (default), and `pedro-stale-session` exists
- when: GET `/api/v1/me` with cookie `ci_session=<stale-token>`
- then:
  - 200 OK
  - the row's `last_seen_at` is within 5 seconds of the request time
  - the row's `expires_at` equals its new `last_seen_at` plus 30 days
  - `Set-Cookie` re-issues `ci_session` with the same value and a `Max-Age` within 5 seconds of 2,592,000

#### `API-EXPIRY-04` — renewal is throttled within one hour
- given: (default), and `pedro-active-session` exists (last seen 10 minutes ago)
- when: GET `/api/v1/me` with cookie `ci_session=<active-token>`
- then:
  - 200 OK
  - the row's `last_seen_at` is unchanged
  - no `Set-Cookie` for `ci_session`

## CLI

**Verification mode:** Read the running api's stdout log stream around the triggering request; assert the presence, absence, and content of structured JSON log lines.

### Login audit logging

#### `CLI-LOGIN-LOG-01` — rejected login logs a hash, never the email
- given: `no-users`; a login was started, and its `ci_oauth` cookie and `state` were captured
- when: GET `/api/v1/auth/google/callback?code=code-other-email&state=<captured state>` with the captured `ci_oauth` cookie, then read the api log lines for that request's correlationId
- then:
  - exactly one JSON line has `msg` "Login rejected"
  - that line has a 16-character lowercase hex `emailHash`
  - the substring "other@example.com" appears in no api log line for that correlationId
